name: SCP Breach Event
summary:
Enter a high tension containment facility where every decision matters and every mistake can end the run.

SCP Breach Event throws you into a dangerous research complex where unknown anomalies have escaped containment. Your goal is simple on paper but far from easy in practice survive, explore, and restore control before everything collapses.
